accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use zinc-500 minimum for subtle text against white.
accessibility.focus: Always provide visible focus rings for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons and purely decorative elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts: Outfit for headings and Manrope for body text.
Install and use lucide-react for all iconography.
Follow the Linear-inspired clean SaaS style: use crisp borders (border-zinc-200), pure white surfaces (bg-white), and off-white backgrounds (bg-zinc-50). Absolutely NO purple or violet gradients.
For the marketing page: Apply generous spacing (p-12 to p-32). Use Outfit for bold headings and Manrope for highly legible body text.
For the dashboard: Maintain a strict, dense grid layout. Cards should have no more than rounded-lg (8px) radius and a subtle shadow-sm. Use high contrast for metrics and tight spacing.
For dashboard charts: Utilize Shadcn Charts or Recharts. The combo chart should use sharp, distinct colors (e.g., blue-600 for visits bar, zinc-800 for conversions line) for crisp aesthetics.
Use standard HTML + Tailwind for marketing layouts to ensure full creative freedom, and highly customized Shadcn components for complex interactive logic like forms, tables, and dialogs.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) have a 'data-testid' attribute for robust automated testing.
